# Emirates Flight Training Academy

> > A premier pilot training institution in Dubai offering integrated ATPL courses with state-of-the-art facilities and direct pathways to Emirates airline careers.

Emirates Flight Training Academy is located at Dubai South and provides comprehensive pilot training programs featuring modern aircraft fleets (Cirrus SR22 G6, Boeing 777, A380 simulators) and advanced training facilities. The academy serves as a recruitment pipeline for Emirates airline and attracts aspiring pilots from across the UAE and internationally.
